decisions.treatment: Of the ฿91,500 transferred on slips 25/26/27, ฿86,500 is August wage cost and ฿5,000 is cash withdrawn for operating float. Cash held is an asset, not a cost, so it does not enter the P&L.
decisions.structural_note: The books have no petty-cash or float account — Daily_Expenses records costs only. This ฿5,000 therefore has nowhere to sit and will simply not appear anywhere, which is the correct P&L answer but means the books do not show cash on hand. If that float is later spent on something, the spend must be booked from its own evidence and must NOT be traced back to these salary slips, or it will double-count.
decisions.distinct_from: Slip 72's ฿5,000 B3 pre-salary advance (13/08) is a different payment with its own evidence. The two ฿5,000 amounts are unrelated.
